notes.title: Demo Update #4
notes.content: [p][/p][p]- You can choose your character's voice along with your character. [/p][p]- In the settings, you can choose how many lives you have during the match. [/p][p]- Visual improvements to the HUD [/p][p]- A NEW VERSUS MODE WHERE YOU CAN HUMILIATE YOUR FRIENDS! (But it will be available in the full game.)[/p][p][/p][p]That's it.[/p]

notes.title: Demo Update #3 - New music
notes.content: [p]New music for menu and the stages.[/p][p][/p]

notes.content:
[p]Unlocked trashtalk until the end of STEAM NEXT FEST event.[/p][p][/p][p]Also little improvements to the Dojo map pixel art (just some shadows).[/p][p][/p][p]Go insults your friends with your custom phrases and tag me on X with a screenshot or a clip of your gameplay in HONORLESS! Remeber to wishlist the game (if you like it).[/p][p][/p][p]Love you all.[/p]

notes.title: Demo Update #2
notes.content: A small update to the demo that improves the 'How to play' section with new information.

notes.title: Demo Update #1
notes.content: A little demo update for better gamepad navigation in the menu, some visual stuff and music in all the stages and other fix i don't remember.

notes.title: DEMO IS OUT!
notes.content:
In the demo you can try the classic Versus battle mode, against a friend or against the CPU. The Dojo and customization will be available in the final release.
(I need your help to improve gameplay and find bugs.)
